data.title: Burj Azizi
data.about:
Introducing Burj Azizi – a groundbreaking new launch by Azizi Developments, set to become the world’s second-tallest tower at an astonishing 725 meters. Nestled along Sheikh Zayed Road, this iconic marvel features ultra-luxury 1–2 bedroom apartments and expansive 2–5 bedroom penthouses, all boasting panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline and the Arabian Gulf. Each residence is crafted to perfection, blending opulence, comfort, and style within a vertical sanctuary of refined living. With over 133 floors, the tower redefines urban luxury and offers a truly immersive residential experience.

Burj Azizi is not just a home; it’s a self-sustaining vertical city that integrates a seven-star hotel, the world’s highest observation deck on the 130th floor, a revolutionary multi-level vertical mall, and fine dining among the clouds. Residents will enjoy amenities like a wellness spa perched at 415 meters, the highest supermarket at 310 meters, a fitness center, community café, and a sky-high nightclub. Positioned in a prime location with direct access to Dubai’s top landmarks, Burj Azizi embodies architectural brilliance, luxury living, and a legacy of innovation for generations to come.

characteristics_module.title: Burj Azizi: A New Global Destination!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Architectural Marvel: Standing at an impressive 725 meters, Burj Azizi, the world’s second tallest building, is set to redefine Dubai’s skyline.
  • Unmatched Records: Burj Azizi will host a range of world-firsts, including the world’s highest nightclub on the 126th floor and the highest observation deck on the 130th floor.
  • Exceptional Dining Experience: Dining at Dubai’s highest restaurant, located on the 122nd floor of Burj Azizi, will provide an extraordinary culinary experience with breathtaking views.
  • World-Class Amenities: Features include a 7-star hotel, luxury residences, the highest spa (415m), the highest supermarket (310m), and vibrant retail options, creating a complete living and leisure destination.
  • Global Landmark: Burj Azizi in Dubai is an up-and-coming cultural and lifestyle destination that seamlessly blends innovation, luxury, and soul-enriching experiences, embodying Dubai’s spirit of progress.

location_tile.title: Burj Azizi Tower: A Prestigious Address in the Heart of Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Dubai Burj Azizi is strategically located in the prestigious Dubai World Trade Center district, placing it at the epicenter of the city’s dynamic business and leisure activities. This prime location ensures residents and visitors enjoy seamless access to key areas of Dubai, including its major financial hubs, iconic landmarks, and entertainment hotspots. With world-class infrastructure and connectivity, Burj Azizi offers the perfect blend of convenience and luxury, making it a highly desirable address for those seeking an exceptional living experience in the heart of Dubai.

  • Dubai World Trade Center - 2 Minutes
  • Museum of the Future - 3 Minutes
  • Dubai Mall - 5 Minutes
  • Business Bay - 10 Minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 15 Minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah - 20 Minutes

more_info.question: What is the launch date of Burj Azizi - world's second tallest building?

more_info.answer: Burj Azizi will reach an impressive height of 725 meters (2,379 feet). It will be second only to the Burj Khalifa in terms of global height rankings.
more_info.question: How tall is the Dubai's Burj Azizi?

more_info.answer: The Burj Azizi will feature over 131 floors, making it a towering presence in Dubai’s skyline. These floors will include luxury residences, a seven-star hotel, and multiple world-class amenities.
more_info.question: How many floors are there in Burj Azizi?

more_info.answer: Investing in Burj Azizi offers a rare opportunity to own property in the world’s second tallest tower, located on the iconic Sheikh Zayed Road. With unmatched amenities like the highest observation deck, 7-star hotel, and record-breaking features, it combines luxury, innovation, and exclusivity. It promises high ROI potential, making it a prestigious asset in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
more_info.question: Why invest in Burj Azizi tower?

more_info.answer: The payment plan for Burj Azizi residences has yet to be released. Buyers and investors can expect flexible options similar to other high-end developments in Dubai.
